anchor.statement: Lemma B.1. Multiplication is bounded on B ρ . For ν = 1, 2, let J ν F be the solution G of YG YY + ν G Y = F that extends smoothly to Y = 0 and satisfies G(0) = 0. Its coefficients are given by (J ν F) α +1 = F α ( α + 1)( α + ν ) , (J ν F) 0 = 0. (B.5) The operator J ν is bounded on B ρ , as are radial averaging, multiplication by Y, and the operators I and ∂ η I. In addition, ⃦ ⃦ J ν [( ∂ η F)(D X G)] ⃦ ⃦ ρ ≤ C ρ ∥F∥ ρ ∥G∥ ρ . (B.6) The same estimate holds if either derivative is omitted or F is replaced by A X (F). Extra undifferentiated factors can be inserted, with one additional algebra constant for each factor.

correspondence.note: The variant of (B.6) with F replaced by A_X(F), and the rule allowing extra undifferentiated factors with one algebra constant each, have no counterpart. The other clauses are stated with explicit constants (64, 80, 80/ε, 5120/ε) for J_r with any r ≥ 1.
